feeds.title: Under 30 Experiences Blog
feeds.description: Under 30 Experiences is a travel community for young people aged from 21 to 35. Follow us to keep up with travel hacks, tips & resources to help you travel the world better. Plus, stunning photos, videos & articles from around the globe.

feeds.title: Pommie Travels Blog
feeds.description: Pommie Travels is award-winning travel blog established in 2009, featuring inspiration and tips for anyone wishing to travel the world. I'm here to give you all the best tips I have learned from all these years of travel, and to help you save money while you're at it!

feeds.title: World of Wanderlust
feeds.description: My name is Brooke Saward, a twenty-something explorer originally from Australia. I created World of Wanderlust as a space to inspire young people to travel more and to travel solo. My blog has become a corner of the internet for solo travellers to find inspiration and advice to plan their next trip.

feeds.title: The Millennial Runaway
feeds.description: Welcome to the Millennial Runaway. I'm a part-time traveller sticking the middle finger up to societal pressures and travelling by whatever means necessary. I hope that in recounting my experiences I will encourage others in my position to travel, and not be overcome with social pressures and media trends.

feeds.title: Anna Everywhere
feeds.description: I'm Anna and I'm a world traveler. So far I visited over 77 countries and lived on 5 continents discovering their cultures, history and learning languages. I want to show you the different aspects of travel experiences and how can you travel with purpose and learn from it.

feeds.title: Young Adventuress Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Liz, and I got my first taste for traveling when I was 16 years old. On my own, 12 years and 50 something countries later, my wanderlust has only grown and the list of countries I want to visit longer. After living in Spain for the past few years and returning home for a stint, I then quit my job and moved to New Zealand and I've been here ever since.

feeds.title: Explorista
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Milou. I'm a twenty-six year old entrepreneur that travels the world. On my blog I inspire female millennials to live a more adventurous life trough my travel guides, tips and videos!

feeds.title: Ashley Abroad
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Ashley, the founder of Ashleyabroad.com. This site began as a chronicle of the year I spent working as an au pair in Paris. Seven years later, Ashley Abroad has become a go-to resource for travellers who love culture, history, art, food, wine, and the occasional outdoor adventure.

feeds.title: The Millennial Abroad
feeds.description: I'm a 20-something millennial committed to living life on my terms. This blog is for anyone curious about living abroad as an American ex-pat, living in France and finding work, traveling to new places, living abroad for extended periods of time, making the choice to move abroad, and seeking excitement and challenge in their life.

feeds.title: Sincerely Elaine Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Elaine. This blog is all about celebrating life and living well from the perspective of a millennial nomad-teacher-book worm turned diplomatic spouse. At sincerely Elaine you'll find travel itineraries, lifestyle favorites & more to inspire, inform entertain you.

feeds.title: Why Wait to See the World?
feeds.description: This is a travel magazine for millennials. We encourage everyone to not wait to see the world by giving them stories, practical information and everything in-between to get you out the door!

feeds.title: The Shooting Star Blog
feeds.description: Exclusive stories at the intersection of meaningful travel, sustainable living, and self discovery. The Shooting Star is a solo, offbeat and responsible travel blog run by Shivya Nath, voted among the best travel bloggers in India.
